item: Adjudicate the C1 routed-defect ledger rows R54.3 and R54.4 against the blind panel; write the two full row objects (with status_at_base) for the L1 to install.

rows.adjudication: triage status kept - the panel is proven wrong
rows.disagreement_reason: The panel seat T57W2PanelR542R543 declared its own verdicts void (blindness_breach) and its 'open' basis rests on 'no lane record discloses the C2.before expansion'; a lane record does disclose it (.ufo/waves/round-55/w1/T55W1Rev02-receipts/R54.3-spotcheck-commit-attribution.txt at base), and the item's own attribution ('expanded at 077d431e') is false - the expansion landed at 19c75588 (amendment 2); 19c75588..077d431e changed only amendments 3-5. The routed defect itself is repaired in the lane record (SCORECARD.md:2585 prints total=13; ER-R54-3 at 2649-2652 records old total=14 -> corrected total=13), and the lane's own disposition table corpus/lessons/round-55.md:57 reads '| R54.3 | FIXED - total=13, the receipt's value |'. No lane line still shows the defect, so no admissible 'open' evidence exists either. The clean ledger-blind wave-3 re-seat T57W3ReseatR542R543 also returns fixed/9cf0146b.

rows.adjudication: panel verdict adopted for both status and status_at_base (nothing fixed this round; 9cf0146b is pre-base)
rows.tie: A4/A8: the commit message names no id and the only paths 9cf0146b touches whose basename occurs in the item text are under .ufo/waves/ (soft-excluded), so the tie rests on A8 - the panel's commit for this id equals the row's commit
rows.residue_out_of_lane: the fleet copy /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/.ufo/reports/round-54/tameshi.md still prints the stale digest 49280fe5; it is not a lane file (git ls-tree of .ufo/reports/ at base is empty) and a lane seat may not edit it

findings.claim: The wave-2 blind-panel seat T57W2PanelR542R543 returned 'open' for R54.3 on the basis 'no lane record discloses the C2.before expansion'.
findings.proof: git -C $S/clone show 5e35699:.ufo/waves/round-55/w1/T55W1Rev02-receipts/R54.3-spotcheck-commit-attribution.txt prints the contract's C2.before at 441c26b, at 19c7558 and at 077d431e with the diffstat containing the change - the expansion IS disclosed in the lane; the same receipt shows the item's own 'expanded at 077d431e' is false (the change landed at 19c75588; 19c75588..077d431e changed only amendments 3-5). The seat also declares its verdicts void (blindness_breach).
findings.effect: R54.3 keeps the triage status 'fixed' / status_at_base 'fixed' with commit 9cf0146b94ddba12d454ebf7288ce6e5c5d535bb. One panel disagreement remains against the currently pinned panel (which records R54.3='open' from the void seat) until the L1 folds the clean re-seat in and re-pins PANEL_SHA256.

findings.claim: With the panel pinned (PANEL_SHA256 = sha256 of .ufo/evidence/round-57/c1/panel.json) the R54.4 row is clean (tie via A8); while the pin is the pending marker the counter refuses it with 'EXPLAIN fixed-not-new R54.4'.
findings.proof: receipts/dry-c1-patched-ledger.txt (unpinned: 'EXPLAIN fixed-not-new R54.4') vs receipts/dry-c1-panel-pinned-current.txt (pinned: no R54.4 line at all). The cause is mechanical: 9cf0146b's message names no id, the item text names no file 9cf0146b touches, and the only paths it touches whose basename occurs in the item text are under .ufo/waves/ (soft-excluded) - receipts/cmd-ancestry-and-tie.txt.
findings.effect: The row is correct as written; it needs the L1's pending pin (or the re-seat re-pin) to be judged clean.

findings.claim: The fleet copy of the round-54 report still prints the stale c2 digest 49280fe5 that R54.4 routes.
findings.proof: grep -n '49280fe5' /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/.ufo/reports/round-54/tameshi.md -> the 'Bind and decide' paragraph; git -C $S/clone ls-tree 5e35699 -- .ufo/reports/ -> empty (the report is not a lane file).
findings.effect: Operator-owned residue outside the lane; the same class is lane-fixed for R54.2 and R54.7, whose fleet copies are equally stale. Reported, not acted on: a lane seat may not write the fleet report.
